column3: The sacrifice is singular in Hebrew; BSB uses plural sacrifices.
The Hebrew repeats the sacrifice and sacrificing root and uses collective cattle and flock.
The Hebrew repeats the burnt offering, grain offering, and fat of peace offerings; BSB replaces the second list with “all these offerings.”
The Hebrew says the eighth day; BSB says the fifteenth. It leaves the sender unnamed and names their tents; BSB supplies Solomon and says they went home.
